query:
INSERT INTO movies (
            uuid,
            interpretation_id,
            title,
            tmdb_id,
            imdb_id,
            tvdb_id,

            original_title,
            original_language,
            tagline,
            overview,
            release_year,
            release_month,
            release_day,
            runtime_seconds,
            tmdb_poster_path,
            sort_title
        )
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        RETURNING id AS "id!: MovieRowId"
